definitions.explanation: Characteristic of traditional Japanese aesthetics, design, cuisine, or culture. Used as a modifier to describe things made in or inspired by Japanese traditions, as opposed to Western-style ({洋風|ようふう}).

examples.japanese: {和風|わふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和風|わふう}⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧にした。
examples.english: I had Japanese-style pasta for lunch today.

examples.japanese: {和風|わふう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洋風|ようふう}→洋風：13282_youfuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせた→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦インテリア→インテリア：22335_interia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Interior design that skillfully combines Japanese and Western styles is popular.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier (⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly prefixed) to describe food, architecture, clothing, design, and other cultural products. Very common in everyday life, especially in food: {和風|わふう}⟦ドレッシング→ドレッシング：11126_doresshingu⟧ (Japanese-style dressing), {和風|わふう}だし (Japanese-style broth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和風|わふう}⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: Japanese-style architecture
- {和風|わふう}⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: Japanese-style inn
- {和風|わふう}⟦ドレッシング→ドレッシング：11126_doresshingu⟧: Japanese-style (soy-based) dressing
- {和風|わふう}だし: Japanese-style broth

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{洋風|ようふう}→洋風：13282_youfuu⟧ means Western-style and is the natural counterpart to {和風|わふう}.
